scripts.test: node scripts/check-sql.mjs && npm run docs:openapi:check && npm test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.cf:test: npm run cf:build && npm test -w @deuceleague/db-d1 && node --test --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings deploy/cloudflare/test/*.test.ts

DB.description: A new D1 database for this club only. Keep the binding name DB; you may rename the database.

PUBLIC_URL.description: Exact HTTPS address players will use, such as https://your-worker.your-subdomain.workers.dev. Use the Worker name chosen above and your account subdomain. No path. See the trial guide if setting this after deployment.

MAIL_PROVIDER.description: Optional, and not asked at deployment: players sign in with links from the coach. To email sign-in links later, add it under vars in wrangler.jsonc as resend (with a RESEND_API_KEY secret) or cloudflare (with an EMAIL binding); see deploy/cloudflare/EMAIL.md.

MAIL_FROM.description: Only with MAIL_PROVIDER: a sender address verified with that provider, such as League <league@your-club.org>.

SETUP_TOKEN.description: Run `openssl rand -base64 32 | tr '+/' '-_' | tr -d '=\n'` and save the output as an independent secret. Enter it later at /install. Never reuse WEBSITE_API_KEY.

WEBSITE_API_KEY.description: Run `openssl rand -base64 32 | tr '+/' '-_' | tr -d '=\n'` again, prefix the output with dl_, and save it. Initialization registers it with website-only scopes.

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Only with MAIL_PROVIDER resend: your Resend sending API key, added later as a Worker secret. It is stored as a Worker secret, not in D1.
